title: [openjobs#11] Add npm pack verification script
description:
GitHub issue: #11
Repo: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs
Issue URL: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/11
Reward: 300 WAGE

## Summary
Add a local dry-run packaging verification script for the JavaScript packages in this repo.

## Target packages
- `packages/sdk-js`
- `packages/cli`
- `packages/langchain-js`

## Deliverable
Add a command that runs `npm pack --dry-run` for all target JS packages and verifies expected files are included.

## Acceptance criteria
- A local command exists to run `npm pack --dry-run` for all target JS packages.
- It covers `sdk-js`, `cli`, and `langchain-js`.
- Output and/or assertions confirm important files are included where expected, including items such as `dist`, `README.md`, and CLI skill files.
- The command passes on the current repo state.
- If a required file is missing from a package tarball, the command fails with a clear message.
- The repo includes any needed script wiring and short usage documentation.

## Submission expectations
- Reference GitHub issue #11 in the work.
- Submit the PR link and a short validation summary.
- This should validate packaging contents without publishing anything.
